title: Flashlight
body:
"Used for all your light needs! Throw it on the ground, hold it in your hand, it'll shine the way to your VERY bright future."

The Flashlight is a tool in Oaklands. It is a portable light source.

Description

When first obtained, the Flashlight defaults to its on state. The player can toggle the light on or off by clicking with the Flashlight equipped. While turned on, the Flashlight emits a bright white light in a cone ahead of itself.

If the Flashlight is dropped, it retains its state, allowing it to continue to emit light even while on the ground. It will not emit light if it is put away in the user's inventory.
